basics.name: Peter Bhabra
basics.label: Software Engineer | AI/ML & Distributed Systems
basics.summary: Software engineer with technical leadership experience in AI infrastructure and distributed systems. Currently leading inference platform development at Doubleword. Previously built high-availability data platforms processing 1M+ files daily at CMR Surgical.

work.name: Doubleword
work.position: Member of Technical Staff - 2023 to Present
work.summary: Built self-hosted inference products before moving to lead the core engineering team for Doubleword’s hosted inference platform.

phases.name: Hosted inference platform
highlights: Lead a five-person engineering team responsible for Doubleword’s core hosted inference platform, and have run hiring processes to grow the team.
Own incident response and on-call coverage for a production inference service operating 24/7.
Developed low-latency Rust backends for real-time and asynchronous inference, including an API gateway benchmarked at 450× faster than LiteLLM.
Implemented durable request processing backed by PostgreSQL, covering dispatch, retries, completion, and failure handling.
Designed and built scheduling systems that connect queued inference requests to available GPU capacity.

phases.name: Self-hosted inference
highlights: Built custom inference engines with scheduling and resource management, and implemented inference research including speculative decoding.
Delivered full-stack, on-premises deployments of open-source LLMs, production APIs, and RAG applications.
Led technical client engagements throughout B2B sales cycles and deployment.
Built a Rust-based inference engine using Candle for Stable Diffusion models.
Built release and deployment automation, Helm charts, and custom Kubernetes operators, and managed self-hosted CI/CD clusters.

work.name: CMR Surgical
work.summary: Worked within an agile, high-performing team delivering scalable data platforms using AWS serverless microservice architecture.
highlights: Built and maintained data platforms processing over one million files per day
Reduced AWS monthly costs from $60,000 to $35,000 (42% reduction) within one month
Built HTTP Live Streaming and fine-grained permissions systems from scratch using Open Policy Agent
Led team projects including facilitating collaboration sessions, breaking down ideas into executable stories, and quarterly planning
Worked with telemetry and video data to deliver customer insights with frontend teams
Utilized CI/CD techniques with TeamCity and GitlabCI for reliable releases across multiple deployment environments
Developed AWS serverless applications using microservice architecture
